risks.risk: Exact Yamaha model is unknown; pricing depends heavily on model tier (entry vs arranger/workstation).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the model label/sticker (usually on the back panel or underside) showing model number (e.g., PSR/YPT/Clavinova series) and serial number.
risks.if_unproven: Price it at the worst-case for an unknown Yamaha keyboard (lowest-tier used) until the model label is provided.

risks.risk: Functionality is not proven (keys, speakers, display, buttons/knobs, power, sustain/pitch controls).
risks.proof: A short video showing power-on, working display, playing several keys, and at least one function (e.g., rhythm/voice change) plus volume/speaker output.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully tested / worst-case not working properly until a working demo is shown.

risks.risk: Cosmetic/physical condition may be worse than it looks (scratches, missing keys/knobs, loose casing).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of: both ends, all control knobs/buttons, keybed (top view), and any ports (rear panel) in good light.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used with possible cosmetic wear until close-ups confirm no missing parts.

risks.risk: Accessories/compatibility not confirmed (power adapter, sustain pedal, stand).
risks.proof: Photo of everything included laid out (adapter, pedal, stand) and rear-panel port types.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming missing accessories (buyer may need to source them) until inclusion is confirmed.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the model/serial label (back or underside) so the exact Yamaha model can be identified.
Video demo: power-on + working screen + playing keys + changing at least one sound/rhythm + speaker/volume check.
Photos of rear panel ports and included accessories (power adapter/pedal/stand).
response.reason: The photos confirm it’s a Yamaha keyboard, but the exact model and working condition are not verifiable from the images. Without the model label and a functional demo, the correct Abuja price cannot be set reliably.
